questions.question_en: Which of the following statements about Article 323B of the Constitution is correct?
options_en: It permits tribunals for matters such as taxation, land reforms and labour disputes.
It permits the establishment of tribunals only for the armed forces.
It limits tribunals exclusively to environmental matters.
It empowers states to establish tribunals for local government.
questions.answer_text: It permits tribunals for matters such as taxation, land reforms and labour disputes.
